title: refactor(panel): migrate Panel widget stack to TypeScript
body:
This migrates the Panel widget stack to TypeScript. This is a non-conventional widget that benefits from being typed.

This anticipates new APIs that we might want to introduce in v5 regarding simplifying its usage (perhaps passing UI state on top of the whole render options).

## Changes

* Migrate the Preact class component to a function (TypeScript + Preact class components don't work with our setup which is why hooks were used)
* The tests haven't changed. They were migrated to `@testing-library/preact`

## Impact

There is a small bundle size increase because we now import `preact/hooks`. This will get "absorbed" once we remove classes from the codebase.
